data.body: Plan-review advisory (partial publish recovery), answered from release.yml: github_release edits an existing release instead of failing, and mcp_registry checks the registry for the version before each attempt, so after a PyPI success, re-running only the failed jobs (gh run rerun <run> --failed) completes the remaining targets. publish itself is never re-run for a version PyPI already holds; a bad artifact is yanked and fixed in a new patch version (docs/releasing.md Hard rules).
